description: This source file defines the MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter class, which implements the TextMap interface to facilitate injecting message annotation properties into an AMQP 1.0 message's annotations, primarily for tracing purposes.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter
classes.description: An adapter that allows injecting key-value tracing data into AMQP message annotations.

methods.name: MessageAnnotationsInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a specific message and annotation map name.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as reading annotations is not supported.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Injects a key-value pair into the message's annotation map.

methods.name: getPropertiesMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the properties map within the message annotations where key-value pairs are stored.
